stages.next_action: Freeze A0 as passed; activate A1 only under a separate request and before downloading or inspecting evaluation data.
stages.objective: Freeze the research-only mandate, jurisdiction and instrument-access states, capital risk budget, data requirements, stage graph, durable handoff and fail-closed validator.
stages.pass_gate: All A0 contracts serialize canonically, referenced artifacts match checksums, unsafe jurisdiction or runtime assumptions fail closed, no instrument or strategy is approved, and actionable output remains no_trade.

stages.next_action: Freeze one exact investable universe and data-source audit before any strategy hypothesis or bulk acquisition.
stages.objective: Qualify point-in-time data and exact executable instrument mappings for a small cross-asset universe under the selected lawful jurisdiction and venue path.
stages.pass_gate: Every instrument has causal prices, total-return or cash-flow treatment, calendars, rules, costs, FX conversion, gap policy and source checksums; current-survivor and ambiguous adjusted series fail closed.

stages.next_action: Record independent acceptance or rejection before selecting a non-trend family.
stages.objective: Evaluate one frozen, diversified cross-asset trend family at fixed risk using chronological and genuinely prospective evidence.
stages.pass_gate: The trend family beats flat, static allocation, matched-exposure and simple controls after all frozen costs with acceptable uncertainty, concentration and drawdown; multiple speeds remain one family.

stages.next_action: Continue to risk overlays only if at least one arm passes; routing still requires two distinct accepted families.
stages.objective: Evaluate one economically distinct non-trend family selected by a pre-result access branch: lawful carry when complete derivative/cash-flow data exist, otherwise liquid-instrument mean reversion.
stages.pass_gate: The chosen family independently passes causal, cost, capacity, robustness, attribution and unseen-evidence gates; no alternative family is opened after observing its PnL.

stages.next_action: Retain the simple risk benchmark regardless of result; do not create a universal directional regime oracle.
stages.objective: Evaluate continuous volatility, correlation and liquidity risk scaling for accepted arms, beginning with simple EWMA and covariance controls.
stages.pass_gate: Risk scaling improves frozen tail and risk-adjusted metrics without changing forecast direction, exceeding leverage limits, or depending on hindsight thresholds.

stages.next_action: Freeze the complete shared-capital system before prospective observation.
stages.objective: Compare no_trade, the best single arm, a static accepted-arm blend and a deterministic risk-aware router using one shared capital account.
stages.pass_gate: At least two economically distinct arms are accepted and routing adds stable net value after costs, uncertainty, turnover and concentration while actionable output remains no_trade.

stages.next_action: Require a new execution mandate, exact venue, credentials review and explicit written approval before any live-capital proposal.
stages.objective: Prospectively paper-observe each accepted arm and the frozen shared-capital portfolio with availability, forecasts, fills, costs, risk and decay attribution.
stages.pass_gate: The frozen observer completes its predeclared duration and opportunity minimums without evidence contamination, unresolved operational failures or drawdown-limit breaches.
